description: Filter the agenticjobs.dev index by free-text and structured constraints. Returns up to `limit` rows sorted by vibe-coding fit, each description cut to 240 characters. The strongest single tool — call this first.

country.description: Full country names (Germany, UK, USA), not ISO codes.

exclude_ids.description: Drop these postings — pass ids the person has already been shown.

ids.description: Narrow to these postings — pass ids from an earlier answer to re-check them under new conditions.

min_score.description: Minimum LLM rubric score: 70 is a good fit, 85 the curated top.

q.description: Free-text — matches title, company, tags, AI-tool names.

tools.description: Restrict to jobs mentioning these AI-coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex).

name: search_jobs
